# Arizona PBS

> Arizona PBS is a public broadcasting station serving Arizona with live TV streaming, on-demand content, membership programs, and community-focused programming including local series about food, hiking, and history.

Arizona PBS (KAET) operates multiple channels and offers streaming access through Arizona PBS Passport membership. The station produces original local content series like Check, Please! Arizona, Trail Mix'd, and What Happened in AZ?, while also featuring national PBS programming and supporting community initiatives through donations and sponsorships.

## Key Topics

## Watch & Streaming

- [Watch Arizona PBS Live](https://azpbs.org/watch-azpbs-live): Live streaming platform for Arizona PBS across devices and apps
- [Watch](https://azpbs.org/watch): Arizona PBS streaming content hub with shows and on-demand video access
- [TV Schedule for Arizona PBS](https://azpbs.org/schedule): TV schedule for Arizona PBS channels 8.1-8.4 with printable guides
- [Arizona PBS Passport](https://azpbs.org/arizona-pbs-passport): Guide to Arizona PBS Passport activation and streaming membership setup

## Featured Series

- [Check, Please! Arizona](https://azpbs.org/checkplease): Check, Please! Arizona series hub featuring local restaurant reviews
- [Trail Mix'd](https://azpbs.org/trailmixd): Trail Mix'd series hub exploring Arizona landscapes and hiking destinations
- [What Happened in AZ?](https://azpbs.org/whathappenedinaz): What Happened in AZ? series on Arizona history and Indigenous cultures
